items.question: In the UAE, up to which grade does the government mandate children's vaccinations, starting from birth?
items.gold: Vaccinations are mandated from birth up to Grade 11.
items.fact: UAE mandates child vaccinations from birth through Grade 11

items.question: Under the UAE Government's children's safety initiatives, is corporal punishment of children allowed?
items.fact: Corporal punishment of children is banned in the UAE
